verified_claims: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.17704417 provides ECG, sEMG, upper-limb inertial data and binary self-reported pain labels.
The record describes 17 healthy participants with DOMS and 6 participants with shoulder musculoskeletal disorders.
limitations: Labels are binary self-reports collected during industrial tasks, not a continuous clinical pain endpoint.
Files total 12.5 GB; this audit checked metadata and file inventory, not the signal contents.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Multimodal human musculoskeletal-pain dataset with ECG, sEMG, IMU and binary self-report labels.
decisions.note: Version 1.0.1 and the exact Zenodo DOI were confirmed.

searches.query: UCL EmoPain dataset chronic pain IMU sEMG

verified_claims: The UCL page describes 18 IMUs and four sEMG sensors for 12 healthy and 18 chronic-pain participants.
Protective behaviour was independently annotated by four domain experts.
limitations: Access to the body-movement component requires contacting the dataset owner.
Protective behaviour is not interchangeable with pain intensity or a clinical outcome.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Controlled-access movement, sEMG and annotation resource for chronic-pain protective behaviour research.
decisions.note: The former generic NIT link was replaced with the official UCL dataset page.

searches.query: LENS Dataset sEMG NIRS jaw clenching pain

limitations: No primary dataset matching the imported name, modalities and jaw-clenching description was found.
The supplied odesi.ca domain is a catalogue landing page and does not identify this resource.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Rejected candidate: no stable identifier or exact primary record could be established.
decisions.note: Do not use the imported modality or task claims as facts unless a primary record is supplied.

verified_claims: OSF identifies the project as Effects of analgesics on EEG biomarkers of chronic pain.
The public storage contains BIDS archives and clinical spreadsheets for two cohorts.
limitations: The imported name OpenPain was incorrect and has been removed from the resource purpose.
The multi-gigabyte archives were not downloaded or independently checked for BIDS validity.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Public OSF project containing BIDS EEG archives and clinical variables for analgesic effects on chronic-pain EEG biomarkers.
decisions.note: Verified through the OSF API because the browser landing page returns an automated-access error.

searches.query: PainLabMunich public resting-state EEG chronic pain dataset

verified_claims: A public PainLabMunich OSF project exists for resting-state EEG from 101 chronic-pain patients and 88 matched controls.
limitations: The imported OSF identifier hbkmx returns 404 and could not be validated.
The replacement srpbg project is a specific PainLabMunich dataset, not a generic record for every lab dataset.
decisions.corrected_purpose: PainLabMunich resting-state EEG dataset for chronic-pain microstate analysis, represented by the verified srpbg project.
decisions.note: Corrected to the closest documented primary project; original identifier remains disproven.

searches.query: chronic neuropathic pain EEG painDETECT BPI 36

verified_claims: Mendeley Data DOI 10.17632/yj52xrfgtz.4 contains resting-state EEG and questionnaire data from 36 chronic neuropathic-pain patients.
The protocol includes five minutes eyes open, five minutes eyes closed, painDETECT and Brief Pain Inventory reports.
limitations: The dataset has no healthy control group and contains heterogeneous etiologies and medication exposure.
It supports within-cohort association or stratification, not causal or population-wide pain inference.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Resting-state EEG plus painDETECT and Brief Pain Inventory data for 36 chronic neuropathic-pain patients.
decisions.note: Exact Mendeley version and data article were matched.

verified_claims: OpenNeuro identifier ds008115 resolves to the ValidPain2 EEG dataset under DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds008115.v1.0.0.
Catalogue metadata reports 180 mechanically ventilated intensive-care patients, four EEG channels and three clinical-procedure tasks.
limitations: Patients were unable to self-report pain; the target concerns responsiveness to potentially nociceptive procedures, not subjective pain intensity.
Signal files were not downloaded or independently quality-controlled in this audit.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Frontal EEG dataset for responsiveness to potentially nociceptive procedures in mechanically ventilated ICU patients.
decisions.note: Nociception-monitor output and behavioural responsiveness must remain distinct from subjective pain.

searches.query: NEMAR phantom limb pain resting-state EEG

verified_claims: NEMAR on006921 provides 64/128-channel resting-state EEG from 38 participants across amputee and intact-control groups.
The BIDS dataset includes eyes-open/eyes-closed tasks and pain-related phenotype data.
limitations: This is a resting-state group-comparison resource, not an evoked pain-intensity dataset.
NEMAR data-quality summaries were not yet published on the checked page.
decisions.corrected_purpose: High-density resting-state EEG and phenotype data for phantom-limb-pain, amputee-control and intact-control groups.
decisions.note: OpenNeuro DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds006921.v1.1.1 is linked by NEMAR.

verified_claims: OpenNeuro ds006374 contains EEG and behavioural data from 36 participants under DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds006374.v1.0.0.
The listed tasks are calibration, expectation/repetition-suppression and detection.
limitations: The source supports study of expectation and nociceptive responses; it does not establish that expectation modulates repetition suppression.
The repository reports many BIDS warnings, so preprocessing assumptions require review before use.
decisions.corrected_purpose: EEG/behavioural dataset for testing expectation effects on repetition suppression in nociception.
decisions.note: The imported causal-sounding summary was narrowed to the study question.

verified_claims: The dataset contains 30-channel, 500-Hz EEG from 30 knee-pain patients performing left/right leg motor imagery.
The associated publication DOI is 10.1038/s41597-025-05767-2.
limitations: The target is motor-imagery class, not pain intensity or nociceptive response.
MOABB reports 32 of 150 raw sessions missing and a label-mapping inconsistency between README and events metadata.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Lower-limb motor-imagery EEG dataset from knee-pain patients; useful as clinical-domain representation data, not a pain-label benchmark.
decisions.note: Exact Figshare record and known completeness caveats were captured.

verified_claims: Mendeley Data DOI 10.17632/kb9pb6tzkg.2 provides fNIRS data and code for 16 participants across cold/heat threshold and tolerance tasks.
The record includes raw and filtered haemoglobin signals plus k-fold and leave-one-subject-out training code.
limitations: Threshold/tolerance task labels are protocol-derived and are not interchangeable with clinical pain states.
Published model results and code reproducibility were not independently rerun.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Evoked fNIRS and code for thermal quantitative sensory testing across cold/heat threshold and tolerance conditions.
decisions.note: Updated to the current Mendeley version 2 record.

verified_claims: NEMAR on005776 contains NIRS data from 11 participants across electrical, thermal, finger-tapping, imagery and resting tasks.
The record links OpenNeuro DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds005776.v1.0.1 and two associated publications.
limitations: The catalogue description mixes painful stimulation and motor tasks; task-level event semantics must be inspected before modeling.
No independent signal-quality analysis was performed.
decisions.corrected_purpose: BIDS fNIRS dataset combining noxious electrical/thermal stimulation and motor-control tasks.

verified_claims: NEMAR on005777 contains NIRS data from 14 participants under baseline, morphine and placebo conditions.
The record links OpenNeuro DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds005777.v1.0.1 and article DOI 10.3389/fnhum.2018.00394.
limitations: The small pharmacological experiment is not a general clinical-pain dataset.
No independent signal-quality or treatment-effect reproduction was performed.
decisions.corrected_purpose: BIDS fNIRS dataset for neural responses to electrical stimulation under baseline, morphine and placebo conditions.

verified_claims: The NITRC project page describes fNIRS during electrical pain under morphine and placebo conditions.
The page links the same 2018 study represented by the NEMAR/OpenNeuro on005777 record.
limitations: This is an alternate project portal for the ST046 study, not an independent cohort.
The checked NITRC page does not establish that downloadable files remain available there.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Legacy NITRC project page for the morphine/placebo fNIRS study also preserved in NEMAR/OpenNeuro.
decisions.note: Count as source provenance, not as a second independent dataset.

verified_claims: The NITRC page describes fNIRS from 11 participants receiving innocuous and noxious electrical stimuli.
The project links publication DOI 10.1038/srep09469.
limitations: This portal overlaps the electrical-stimulation component represented in ST045 and is not an independent cohort.
Thermal and motor tasks available in the later NEMAR package are not established by this page alone.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Legacy NITRC page for the 11-participant electrical-stimulation fNIRS study represented in the broader NEMAR package.
decisions.note: Count as source provenance, not as a second independent dataset.
